title: An Assessment of Human vs. Model Uncertainty in Soft-Label Learning and Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2605.18648v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Central to human-aligned AI is understanding the benefits of human-elicited labels over synthetic alternatives. While human soft-labels improve calibration by capturing uncertainty, prior studies conflate these benefits with the implicit correction of mislabeled data (mode shifts), obscuring true effects of soft-labels. We present a controlled audit of soft-label learning across MNIST and a synthetic variant, re-annotating subsets to extract human uncertainty. By decoupling soft-label supervision from underlying label mode shifts, we show that while human soft-labels do provide accuracy gains, their larger value lies in acting as a regularizer that improves model calibration on difficult samples and promotes stable convergence across training runs. translated_title: 软标签学习与校准中人类不确定性与模型不确定性的评估
translated_abstract: 以人为本的对齐AI的核心在于理解人类提供的标签相较于合成标签的优势。虽然人类软标签通过捕捉不确定性能够改善模型校准，但先前的研究将这些优势与对错误标注数据的隐式纠正（模态偏移）混为一谈，从而掩盖了软标签的真正效果。我们对MNIST及其合成变体上的软标签学习进行了受控审计，通过重新标注数据子集来提取人类不确定性。通过将软标签监督与底层标签模态偏移解耦，我们证明人类软标签确实能带来准确率提升，但其更大的价值在于作为一种正则化器，能够改善模型对困难样本的校准，并促进训练过程中的稳定收敛。数据集制图分析表明，使用人类软标签训练的模型能够反映人类的不确定性，而使用合成标签训练的模型则无法与人类对齐。总体而言，这项工作……（原文截断）
tldr: 本研究通过解耦软标签监督与标签模态偏移，发现人类软标签的主要价值在于作为正则化器提升模型对困难样本的校准能力和训练收敛稳定性，并使模型的不确定性表现与人类一致。
en_tdlr: This study decouples soft-label supervision from label mode shifts, revealing that the primary value of human soft-labels lies in acting as a regularizer that improves model calibration on difficult samples, promotes stable convergence, and aligns model uncertainty with human uncertainty.
